conversation.title: The Conversation We Must Have
conversation.sub: Understanding where we came from, confronting where we are, and shaping where we go next.
texts: How have Malaysia’s many histories shaped our identity, institutions and relationships today?
What realities, divisions and shared aspirations define our nation at this moment?
What must we change, protect and create for the generations that follow?

about.title: About the Dialogue
about.sub: A National Conversation About Who We Are, and Who We Choose to Become
body: As Malaysia approaches Merdeka 70 and looks towards Malaysia 100, we stand at an important moment: to reflect honestly on the nation we have inherited and decide, together, the nation we want to build.
The Seri Negara Dialogue brings leaders, thinkers and citizens together to confront difficult questions, bridge our differences and find common ground for Malaysia’s future.
about.closing: Many histories have shaped us. Our next chapter must be written together.
about.invite: Be part of the conversation. Help shape Malaysia’s next chapter.
about.imageAlt: The grand hall of Muzium Negara, lit by afternoon sun through carved timber screens.
about.ambitionBody: The first Dialogue is held in 2026. It is built to return each year, so the conversation accumulates rather than restarts.

theme.title: 2026 Theme
theme.name: Many Histories. One Future.
theme.body: How do we understand the histories that formed us, confront the realities shaping Malaysia today, and build a future in which every Malaysian can belong and thrive?
theme.quote: A nation is not only inherited. It is renewed by every generation willing to listen, question and build together.
convTexts: How have Malaysia’s many histories shaped our identity, institutions and understanding of who belongs?
What realities must we confront honestly to rebuild trust, strengthen our institutions and hold together a diverse nation?
What must we choose and create today so that the next generation inherits a Malaysia of dignity, opportunity and belonging?

privacy.title: Privacy notice
body: The details you give when registering are collected by the organising team of Seri Negara Dialogue for one purpose: managing attendance at the event on 8 October 2026.

They are used to confirm your place, to plan seating and catering, and to contact you about this event. They are not sold, and they are not shared with third parties beyond what the venue requires for access.
You may ask for your details to be corrected or removed at any time by writing to the organising team.
